item.title: Version 1.6.0-beta (88)
item.description:
Trails RG Studio 1.6.0-beta

Build 88

  • Each photo keeps its own grade, logo, frame, crop, and caption. A new photo starts plain.
  • Save edit stores that recipe and applies it only when you choose it.
  • Hold for original and Compare show the photo before the grade, logo, frame, and caption.
